rationale: TopKGate applies topk to raw logits instead of post-softmax gates. detection_method=source_analysis: softmax is monotonic so topk indices may match between buggy and correct implementations; only the gate weights differ. No runtime trace field can reliably distinguish buggy vs clean — must read source. Per anti-example 9, source-only bugs are pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6. parallel_dim=none (single-GPU MoE reproduces). Borderline numerical vs moe: chose moe because the bug is specific to MoE router algorithm, not generic numerical math.

Constant SEQ_PARALLEL_COMMUNICATION_DATA_TYPE used 'seq_parallel_comm_data_type' but documented key is 'seq_parallel_communication_data_type', so user-set value is silently dropped. Detection: after engine.initialize, the parsed comm dtype must equal the user-supplied value. Single-rank, single-field comparison -> schema_only. Pattern P1: deterministic expected value derived from user config. Tier exceeds_tier6 because the required field (engine internal _param_dict / parsed config dtype) is not in the standard Tier 0-6 trace schema. Category control_flow per config_parsing -> control_flow mapping. Borderline pattern none vs P1: chose P1 because runtime can compare user-supplied vs engine-parsed values; not pure source-only.

WarmupCosineLR.get_lr() returned a scalar rather than a list of length num_param_groups. Detection: single-rank check that len(scheduler.get_lr()) == len(optimizer.param_groups). Layer schema_only: no cross-rank compare and no module-attr precond needed (rule applies to all schedulers uniformly). Borderline value_equality vs completeness (anti-example 12): chose completeness because the invariant is over the set of param-group LRs (cardinality), not a single value matching a constant. Pattern P1 because the trace field 'len(get_lr())' has a deterministic expected value derived from optimizer config.

Engine sets has_zero_optimizer_state = zero_optimization() or bfloat16_enabled(); when bf16+ZeRO0 the flag is True but no ZeRO state actually exists, causing wrong checkpoint save/load path. Detection reads engine state flag and asserts it matches zero_optimization() (single-value, anti-example 12: value_equality not completeness). Layer is schema_topo_precond — single rank but precond guard is 'bf16 enabled with zero_stage=0'. P7 (module/engine state flag) over P4 (dtype/shape). check_stage=init: the wrong flag is set during deepspeed.initialize before step 0 (anti-example 10). Tier 6 because zero_stage flag is in Tier 6 supplements.

ZeRO3 only saves trainable params; frozen params silently omitted. Detection compares model.named_parameters() set vs the saved state dict's param-name set (anti-example 12: completeness, not value_equality). Layer is schema_topo_precond: precond is 'ZeRO stage 3 + has frozen params' and check is scoped to checkpoint_save phase, but rule is the same per rank without cross-rank topology. P8 because named_parameters set vs saved-name set is statically observable on each rank at save time. Tier 6 needs named_parameters set field.

MoE+TP save_checkpoint short-circuit caused only mp_rank_00_model_states.pt to be written; non-zero TP ranks silently skipped. Invariant: set of mp_rank_XX_model_states.pt files must cover all X in [0, tp_world_size). Layer schema_topo_precond: requires cross-rank set check AND a precond guard (only applies when MoE+TP>1; non-MoE save path is correct). Pattern P7 (function_call_counting per detection_method: counts of save calls per TP rank). Borderline P3 vs P7: chose P7 because the check is on call-counting / file-emission completeness, not on the equality of a replicated tensor across ranks. Category checkpoint over moe because the failure mode is loss of checkpoint state.

MoE expert checkpoint metadata stores dp_world_size instead of seq_dp_world_size; loader uses wrong divisor and slices the wrong fragment. Detection: checksum of MoE expert param post-load must equal the fragment that the same rank wrote at save (anti-example 7: detected at load). Layer is schema_topo_precond — precond guards 'MoE module + sequence_parallel_size>1' and the equality is per-rank (save fragment vs load fragment), not pure cross-rank replication. P1 over P3: not 'all DP ranks should agree' but 'this rank's loaded value should equal this rank's saved value'. Tier 0 since param_checksum suffices.

FP16_Optimizer.get_grad_norm wrongly skips tp_rank>0 slices for genuine TP-sliced params. Reported total_norm is finite, valid-looking, ~1/sqrt(tp_size) of truth. Per anti-example 11, detection requires running a TP=1 reference with same seed/batch and comparing grad-norm — implementation_equivalence with no observable runtime field that reveals the mistake on a single buggy run. Therefore source-only: pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6. category=gradient_sync because root cause is reduction-mask logic, not communication-group misconfig (anti-example 3).

WarmupLR hardcoded warmup_max_lr=0.001 instead of inheriting optimizer's configured lr. After warmup completes, scheduler lr must equal optimizer's configured lr. Single-rank, single-field check; no cross-rank compare and no module-attr guard needed -> schema_only. Pattern P1 because lr (Tier 3 trace field) has a deterministic expected value from config. Borderline value_equality vs implementation_equivalence (anti-example 11): chose value_equality because the expected value is a known config constant (0.005), not the output of a reference scheduler implementation.

TopKGate.wg gets rebound to a fresh fp32 Linear inside forward, orphaning the ZeRO-tracked parameter. Detection requires checking that wg.weight.data_ptr stays constant across forwards AND that wg.weight remains in DeepSpeed's tracked parameter set. Layer schema_topo_precond: precond guard is 'TopKGate module + ZeRO stage>=1 + fp16/bf16 mixed precision' (rebind only triggers under that combo). Pattern P4 because detection reads module attr (the bound submodule's weight tensor) at runtime hook, not a static class check. Tier 6 needs named_parameters set membership. Borderline P4 vs P7: P4 chosen because the check is on identity/membership of a parameter object, not a counter/flag.

Sigmoid for aux-loss must run in fp32 but receives bf16 logits. Layer is schema_topo_precond per anti-example 1: detection reads one field (op input dtype) but needs precond guard 'this specific sigmoid in compute_routing_scores_for_aux_loss'. Borderline P1 vs P4: chose P4 because op input dtype is not a default trace field and needs runtime hook. parallel_dim=none per anti-example 6 (single-GPU MoE reproduces). Tier 0 because dtype is a Tier 0 field, scope is op-level not param-level.

Recompute reruns router under no_grad; buggy guard checks only self.training so tracker double-increments. Count tracker calls, gate by torch.is_grad_enabled. monotonic (per-step bound). Layer=schema_topo_precond: precond is self.training AND grad_enabled. P7 over P1: counter not default field.

topk=1 then post-topk softmax over [N,1] = 1.0, so router_logits.grad is zero. Assert grad norm > 0 at routed expert. value_range (non-zero bound), not implementation_equivalence (no ref impl). P5, Tier 1. Layer=schema_topo_precond: precond is topk==1 AND use_pre_softmax=False.

Aux coeff should be config.moe_aux_loss_coeff/tp_size; missing divide inflates post-allreduce grad by tp. Assert coeff equals expected formula. value_equality (known config+topo expression), not implementation_equivalence. P1, Tier 3. Layer=schema_topo_precond: precond is TP>1 AND MoE aux on.

After load_state_dict, ChainedOptimizer.param_groups must equal concat of inner.param_groups by identity. Stage=checkpoint_load. completeness (list-equivalence). Layer=schema_topo_precond: precond is is_chained_optimizer. P7 over P8: only observable after runtime load mutates groups.

TopKRouter missing calculate_per_token_loss attr post-__init__; detect.py hasattr check on router build = named_modules attr-set assertion → P8. Layer=schema_topo_precond: precond is config.calculate_per_token_loss=True. Tier 6 (named-attr snapshot). P8 over P7: statically inspectable.

Under precision-aware opt, grads_for_norm must read decoupled_grad (._local_tensor if __fsdp_param__), not param.grad. value_equality (known source), not implementation_equivalence. Layer=schema_topo_precond: precond is __fsdp_param__ + precision-aware conjunction. P5 over P4: feeds grad-norm.

HybridCPDataLoaderWrapper.pad_granularity must equal 128 when HybridEP is enabled. Detection reads a module attribute at init time and compares to a configured constant. Layer is schema_topo_precond: precond guard is 'HybridEP dispatcher active' (rule does not apply when only MXFP8 path is used). Borderline P4 vs P8: chose P4 because the attribute value depends on runtime config selection between MXFP8 (32) and HybridEP (128); needs a runtime hook reading module attr, not a pure static class assertion. Category control_flow per config_invariant -> control_flow mapping. Tier 6 because detection needs named_modules class snapshot + module attr inspection.

In _do_adaptive_clipping the EMA update lerps grad_norm_exp_avg toward max_norm_ratio*EMA itself instead of the actual current grad norm — a self-referential update that converges to a fixed point. Both buggy and correct code call lerp_ with finite arguments; only the target operand differs. No standard trace field exposes the lerp source operand. Detection requires source-level inspection or op-level hook on the specific lerp_ call. Per anti-example 9, source-only bugs are pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.

Under use_mup=true, transformer.ff_out.weight must remain all zeros after model construction (MuReadout zero-init), but reset_parameters re-runs init_normal and overwrites it. Detection reads ff_out.weight checksum at build time, conditional on config.use_mup attribute — a precond guard makes this schema_topo_precond, not schema_only (anti-example 1). P4 because we hook the module to read weight values vs config attr, not a static class-only check. Borderline P4 vs P8: the bug is a value, not a class choice, so P4. Tier 0 (param checksum).

restore_checkpoint() forgot to reset self.global_step alongside epoch/tokens when cfg.restore_dataloader=False, so resumed run keeps the checkpoint's step counter (e.g., 50000) and skips warmup. Detection reads global_step right after restore and asserts ==0 (single value, anti-example 12: value_equality not completeness). Layer is schema_topo_precond: single-rank check but the assertion only applies under precond cfg.restore_dataloader=False. P1 because step is a standard Tier 0 trace field. check_stage=init: bug visible immediately after restore_checkpoint, before training step 0 (anti-example 10).

per_param metric tensors default to CPU and are passed to dist.all_reduce; NCCL needs CUDA, so backend silently falls back to gloo with different reduction semantics. Detection reads each tensor's device at the all_reduce call — observable as a runtime hook around the collective. Schema_topo_precond because the rule is conditional on 'this all_reduce being on the NCCL communicator' (precond on backend/topology), not pure cross-rank equality. Category=communication (anti-example 3: root cause is wrong group/backend, not reduction op). Tier exceeds_tier6 because tensor.device per call is not in Tier 0-6 trace schema.

Buggy contiguous slice gives each worker a num_workers-wide window starting at worker_id, so leftover indices overlap and miss; fix uses strided slicing. Both versions return a valid (possibly empty) array and downstream collator never raises, so training silently duplicates/drops samples. Detection requires inspecting the per-worker leftover index sets across workers and checking union==full set — not in Tier 0-6 schema (dataloader internals). Per anti-example 9, source-only/dataloader-internal bugs are pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6. parallel_dim=FSDP per OLMo+FSDP convention.

wte built with vocab_size while ff_out built with embedding_size; when embedding_size>vocab_size the loss softmax has phantom logits with no learnable embedding row. Pure static shape consistency check: read wte.num_embeddings and ff_out.out_features from named_modules at build time and assert equality (anti-example 10: build, not init — defined at __init__). P8 because detectable solely via named_modules static assertion. schema_topo_precond because the equality rule depends on config (weight_tying flag and embedding_size attr). Tier 6 (named_modules class snapshot). Borderline category numerical vs control_flow: chose control_flow because root cause is a config-key wiring mistake, not numerics.

DeepSpeedTrainer used WarmupLR (warmup-then-flat) instead of WarmupDecayLR (warmup-then-decay), so post-warmup lr plateaus rather than decaying. Detection observes lr over consecutive steps after warmup and asserts monotonic decrease toward warmup_min_lr (monotonic, not implementation_equivalence: no reference run needed since flat-vs-decreasing is directly visible from the lr trace). Layer is schema_topo_precond — single rank but precond guards 'step > warmup_steps' and the assertion only valid in the decay phase. P1 reads lr (Tier 3 control variable). category=lr_schedule per table A mapping of scheduler bugs.

Local as_tensor() casts non-bool numpy via astype(np.int_), silently truncating float soft_target_probs to 0. Detection reads tensor dtype (Tier 0) at dataloader output: it must be float for soft_target_probs. schema_topo_precond per anti-example 1: precond is 'this tensor is the soft_target_probs/float-input slot', not just 'any tensor'. P4 (runtime hook on dataloader output) over P1 because the field is not in the standard trace schema.

Transformer.apply_activation_checkpointing hard-coded preserve_rng_state=False even with nn.Dropout in the graph; backward recompute uses a fresh mask so gradients mismatch the original forward. Detection: at build, scan named_modules for nn.Dropout; if any exists, the checkpoint wrapper config must have preserve_rng_state=True. P8 (static named_modules class snapshot). Tier 6 (named_modules class snapshot). schema_topo_precond: precond is 'activation checkpointing enabled AND a Dropout module exists'.

freeze_params=['teacher.*'] missed shared 'blocks.*' params because share_blocks_between_teacher_and_student=True. Detection statically iterates named_parameters() after freeze applied: every param that should be frozen per recipe intent must have requires_grad=False. P8 because this is a build-time named_parameters snapshot check, no runtime needed. Tier 6 (named_parameters set with requires_grad). schema_topo_precond: precond is 'this is a stage1 BLT recipe with share_blocks=True'. Original 'freeze' category mapped to control_flow per prompt mapping.

OLMoE3 recipe used CosWithWarmup where WSD was intended. Both schedulers produce monotonic finite lr curves; runtime trace cannot tell which scheduler class is 'correct' for a given recipe — only the recipe author knows the intent. Per anti-example 11, this is implementation_equivalence (need reference WSD run for ground truth). Per anti-example 9, source-only intent mismatch ⇒ pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6. Original 'scheduler' category mapped to lr_schedule.

PoE branch adds output.z_loss (a detached metric tensor with requires_grad=False) into combined_loss; the z_loss value shows in metrics but contributes zero gradient. Detection reads requires_grad attr on every tensor summed into combined_loss before backward — must be True. schema_topo_precond: precond is 'tensor is operand of combined_loss in PoE branch'. P4 over P1 because requires_grad on a runtime tensor is not in standard trace; needs forward hook. Borderline value_equality vs other: requires_grad must equal True (constant).

copy_grads_in_partition only accumulates when ga_steps>1, missing micro_step_id>0 case in manual GA — CPU buf underestimates norm. Grad_norm trend gated on 'cpu_offload, ga_steps==1' precond. Borderline optimizer_state vs offload: chose offload — root cause is cpu-offload gating.

WarmupCosineLR multi-group init: get_lr returns [0.0] instead of one entry per group. Set-length completeness check on lr list vs num param groups; no cross-rank or module attr precond. Borderline value_equality vs completeness: completeness — set/length check.

_take_model_step hits 'pass' branch for bf16+ZeRO0 so zero_grad never called; grads accumulate forever. Single-rank grad_norm at step start should equal 0 if pre-backward — gated on 'bf16+ZeRO0' precond. Borderline P1 vs P5: chose P5 — magnitude/monotonic bound across steps.

Same family as D-021: ZeRO-3 reduce_and_partition_stream syncs against default_stream not current_stream — sporadic NaN partitions due to race. Non-deterministic, not pinnable to a single trace field; source-only.

Loss double-scaling: scale_if_loss applied to gas_scaled_loss in backward. Bug is a duplicated multiplication; loss value alone looks plausible without reference run. No Tier 0-6 trace field discriminates. Source-only by inspection.

ZeRO-1/2 CPU-offload loses grads when multiple backward() per step. Same family as D-010/D-012/D-NEW-13: grad_norm trend over microsteps gated on cpu_offload precond reveals underaccumulation. Borderline gradient_sync vs offload: chose offload — gating logic specific to offload path.

extra_large_param uses param.dtype not comm_dtype for gradient comm — silently dropped/wrong-dtype grad. dtype check at all_reduce gated on 'extra_large_param path active' precond. Same family as D-028, D-030. Borderline gradient_sync vs dtype: dtype is the root cause.

BF16_Optimizer wrongly selected for bf16+fp32_grad_accum without ZeRO. Single-rank check that the actually instantiated optimizer class matches the expected dispatch given config; no cross-rank or module attr precond. Borderline P4 vs P7: chose P7 — checking module class flag, not dtype/shape.

ZeRO-1/2 elastic ckpt re-flatten alignment ignores nccl_start_alignment_factor*world_size padding used at save. Pre-save vs post-load optimizer.state[p] equality, gated on 'elastic load with different world size' precond. Borderline P7 vs P1: chose P1 — direct value equality on Tier 4 fields.

ZeRO-2 allreduce_bucket hard-resets rank=None — single-rank-reduce path never taken. Expected dist op name (dist.reduce vs dist.all_reduce) gated on use_multi_rank_bucket_allreduce=False precond. Borderline P6 vs P7: chose P7 — op-call counter, not group-size config.

ZeRO-3 contiguous_gradients off-by-one: param exactly filling bucket dropped from reduce. Grad-zero-after-backward when expected non-zero, gated on 'param.numel==bucket free space' precond. Borderline P3 vs P5: chose P5 — single-rank zero/non-zero check, not cross-rank.

load_module_only with bf16 skips refresh_fp32_params (guarded by fp16_enabled), so fp32 master weights remain default-init. Field equality fp32_groups_flat[i] == bf16_groups_flat[i].float() gated on 'bf16 and load_module_only=True and load_optimizer_states=False' precond.

Copy-paste typo in zero.Init.__init__ assigns to self.quantized_weights instead of self.quantized_nontrainable_weights. Single-rank attr-vs-config equality; no cross-rank or other module attr precond. Borderline P4 vs P7: chose P7 — counter/flag attr value, not dtype/shape.

__avg_scatter_contiguous_grads inverted gate: cast happens only when no cast needed, so reduce-scatter runs in wrong dtype. dtype check at all_reduce stage gated on 'communication_data_type != model dtype' precond. Anti-example 1 dtype family.

Two related bugs: bf16 wrapper picked even with cpu_offload; extra_large_param uses raw param.grad instead of get_gradient_for_reduction. dtype/object identity check on reduction tensor gated on 'use_grad_accum_for_reduction=True and extra_large_param path' precond.

fp32->fp16 master-weight copy uses outer-loop partition_id; MoE groups have different real_dp_process_group ranks so wrong slice updated. Cross-rank/group equality gated on 'MoE EP group != DP group' precond. Borderline sharding vs moe: chose moe — root cause is MoE group mismatch.

Optimizer groups must contain only requires_grad=True params; bug includes frozen ones. Set-membership check across params; no cross-rank or other module attr precond. Borderline value_equality vs completeness per anti-example 12: completeness — set check.

Same as D-NEW-29 but in DeepSpeedCPUAdam path: outer partition_id used across groups so non-first groups receive wrong rank's partition. Cross-rank/group equality gated on 'multiple groups with different real_dp_process_group' precond. Borderline moe vs offload: chose offload — bug in CPU-Adam.

param_to_partition_ids built from fp16_groups but reduction uses round_robin_fp16_groups — owner mismatches reducer; some grads never reach optimizer. Two-table consistency gated on 'round_robin_gradients=True' precond. Borderline P3 vs P7: chose P7 — flag/index mapping check.

partition_balanced returns degenerate boundaries [0,2,4,5,5] for 5/4 — last stage owns 0 layers. Static assertion at build time on the boundary list satisfies P8 (module-class enumeration). Borderline P7 vs P8: chose P8 — directly assertable on named_modules at build, no runtime hook.

MiCS: save_non_zero_checkpoint True on every rank — racing writes to same file. Set-cardinality check 'exactly mics_shard_size ranks have save_non_zero_checkpoint=True' gated on 'MiCS enabled' precond. Borderline value_equality vs completeness: completeness — set-size check across ranks.

all_gather_coalesced builds one flat partition buffer assuming single ds_tensor dtype across the group; mixed-dtype params get bytes truncated/aliased. dtype consistency check across params in same allgather, gated on 'param group has mixed floating dtypes' precond. Same family as D-042.

Train/eval coordinators share same InflightParamRegistry instance — inflight handles cross-fire on mode switch. id() inequality between two coordinators gated on 'ZeRO-3 with overlap_comm/prefetch' precond. Borderline P4 vs P7: P7 — flag/object check, not dtype/shape.

ZeRO step unscales grad-norm by post-decay loss_scale instead of prev_scale used during backward. Equality scaled_norm == norm * prev_scale gated on 'fp16 dynamic loss scaling, scale just halved' precond. Borderline P1 vs P5: chose P5 — grad-norm/scale invariant.

SparseTensor wraps param.grad.data into local var never written back; param.grad keeps pre-allreduce value. Value-equality check post-allreduce gated on 'param.grad is sparse' precond. Borderline data_loading vs gradient_sync: chose data_loading — root cause is sparse-embedding plumbing.

_aggregate_total_loss broadcasts bf16 stack but other PP ranks pre-allocate fp32 receive buffers — bytes silently misinterpreted. Cross-PP-rank dtype equality on losses tensor, gated on 'bf16 model and PP>1' precond.

zero_wrapper rebinds local 'tensor' after .to(target_fp_dtype) but model still holds original Parameter — model param keeps wrong dtype. dtype check on the model-visible param gated on 'inside zero.Init context' precond.

ZeRO-3 _create_fp16_partitions includes frozen params, then Adam updates them — silently un-frozen. Pre/post-step param-checksum equality gated on 'requires_grad=False' precond. Borderline P3 vs P7: chose P7 — flag-driven equality, not cross-rank.

Backward hook closure late-binds loop var i; all hooks fire with last group index, routing earlier grads to wrong bucket. Equality 'hook bucket_id == param's group index' gated on 'multiple param groups, ZeRO-3' precond. Borderline P3 vs P7: chose P7 — index routing check.

ZeRO/BF16 wrappers eagerly call inner optimizer.step() during init to materialize state, incrementing Adam state['step'] before any real update — bias-correction off by one for first step. Equality optimizer.state[p]['step']==0 after deepspeed.initialize; no cross-rank or precond.

grad_accum_dtype buffer must equal model_dtype. Precond: ZeRO enabled + grad_accum_dtype unset. P4 over P1 because reading the optimizer-internal buffer dtype needs a runtime hook, not standard trace.

Two boundary flags must be equal at allreduce_gradients entry. Precond: PP+ZeRO active. P7 (counter/flag check). Borderline gradient_sync vs control_flow: control_flow because root cause is a flag never being propagated, not the reduction op (anti-example 3).

len(dataloader) must equal a deterministic function of sampler length and batch_size. Single-rank check, no topology, no module attr — schema_only. Tier exceeds_tier6 because dataloader.len is not in the standard trace tier list. P1 because it is a single-field equality vs known formula.

Buffer dtype must equal configured grad_accum_dtype. Per anti-example 1, even pure-dtype bugs need a precond (which buffer, when configured to bf16). Single-rank but precond on config attr → schema_topo_precond. P4: hook reads optimizer attr, not in default trace.

extra_large_param_to_reduce must be None when contiguous_gradients=False. Precond on that config. P7 (state-flag check). Tier exceeds_tier6: optimizer-internal attr not in tiers. Borderline gradient_sync vs control_flow: control_flow because bug is a stale flag (anti-example 3).

Detection requires reference (DP=N, EP=1) vs (EP=ep) parity comparison. No single-run field exposes missing ep_size scale. Source-only per anti-example 9: pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6. moe over numerical because scale is AutoEP-specific.

Wrong divisor (edp vs dp) detectable only via matched (EP=1) reference. No standalone field exposes scaling error. Source-only per anti-example 9: pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6. moe over numerical because divisor logic is EP-specific.
locations must equal cumsum(mask)-1 (algebraic relation). Precond: drop_tokens=False branch + capacity update fired. P2. Tier exceeds_tier6: op-level intermediates not in standard trace.

After load, ds_secondary_tensor must equal slice of refreshed ds_tensor. Precond: ZeRO++ hierarchical partitioning. P7 (per-module freshness flag). Tier 0 (param checksum). Stage=checkpoint_load per anti-example 7.

Intermediate-value precision loss in CUDA kernel; output tensor has correct dtype/shape. No runtime field distinguishes 'fp32 with 13 mantissa bits truncated' from normal fp32. Source-only per anti-example 9: pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.

Hard-coded constant in C++ kernel — runtime cannot observe the divisor used inside the .so. Reduced gradient values do reflect the bug but indistinguishable from other comm errors without a parity reference. Effectively source-only: pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.

After load, distinct global DP ranks have identical partition checksums when they should differ — cross-rank divergence visible at load. Precond: multi-node ZeRO-3 + universal checkpoint. P3 (cross-rank pattern). Tier 0 (param checksum).

After has_overflow, overflow flag and loss_scale must agree across DP ranks (cross-rank replication). Precond: ZeRO stage 1 + fp16 dynamic loss scaler. P3 because the bug is detected as values that should be equal across DP ranks but aren't. Tier 3 (loss_scale is a control variable).

At Adam.step entry, grad dtype must equal partition dtype (fp32). Precond: BF16_Optimizer + grad_acc_dtype=bf16. P4 because dtype check on optimizer-internal partition needs a runtime hook (not standard trace). Tier 0 (dtype field).

Bug is non-idempotent C++ counter logic across subgroup calls; betta_t values inside DeepSpeedCPUAdam kernel are not exposed to Python. Difference is sub-ULP floating-point. Source-only: must read the IncrementStep cpp branch logic. Pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.

On non-last PP stages, hp_grad must equal exactly one cast of lp.grad (not 2x). Precond: PP>1 + bf16 + immediate_grad_update=True. P5 because detection compares hp_grad scale/value to lp.grad — gradient norm/scale boundary check via hook. Tier 1 (gradient stats).

Cached per-param L2 norm must match current grad's recomputed norm after set_local_grad. Precond: ZeRO-3 + CPU offload + safe_set_local_grad call. P5 (gradient norm boundary). Tier 1 (gradient stats). value_equality because cached norm should equal recomputed norm.

When autocast(fp16)+ZeRO-0, a non-trivial loss_scale must be installed. Precond: specific config combo. P7 because it is a missing-flag/state-counter check on the engine (no GradScaler attached). Tier 3 (loss_scale is a control variable).

Stream-synchronization race: requires CUDA stream/event timeline observation, not exposed in any standard trace. Manifests as nondeterministic gradient corruption only in some windows. Effectively source-only: pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6. invariant_type=other (sync ordering).

Symmetric with D-NEW-68: missing wait_stream(reduction_stream) on current stream. Detection requires CUDA stream timing knowledge — not in any tier. Source-only: pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.

Buffer passed to average_tensor must be narrow(0,0,elements_in_ipg_bucket); detectable as a length-mismatch hook. Precond: contiguous_gradients=True + bucket flushed early. P5 because grad-buffer scope/size check before allreduce. Tier exceeds_tier6 (ipg_buffer length is not in tier list).

Padding bytes appended before reduce_scatter must equal zero. Precond: ZeRO-3 + last partition shorter. P5 (grad-buffer pre-comm check). Tier exceeds_tier6: padding-byte tail values are not a standard trace field.

Reshape collapses batch/seq dims wrongly. Detection requires running a roundtrip identity test (run reference inverse and compare element-wise) — implementation_equivalence parity. No single-run trace field reveals the wrong reshape. Source-only: pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.
